intro: Lantern Cafe's cupboard, wired from the scan. The SSH guesses on portal01 came from 203.0.113.66, out on the internet.

tasks.text: Take till-pc off the network, but leave it switched on: someone made a new account on it
tasks.hint: Pull its cable at socket D1, or shut its switch port.

tasks.text: Stop SSH to portal01 from the internet, for every address and not only the attacker's
tasks.hint: Click the router and write rules. Deny tcp 22 from the internet to 10.9.0.10, then allow the rest.

tasks.text: The portal still reaches the internet on 443
